priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P1] Restore message-handler removal in the cleanup callback
findings.body: Calling the function returned by attach no longer unregisters the handler. The handler therefore continues processing messages after teardown, and repeated attach/cleanup cycles accumulate listeners, causing duplicate processing and memory retention.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current `src/socket.ts:3` still returns a no-op cleanup (`return () => {};`) after registering the handler with `socket.on("message", handler)`, so disposal never unregisters the listener.
